title: From Failures to Global Glory: 2026 Cancer Breakthrough
description:
Meet the 2026 team that turned cancer into a failure.
From gene‑editing trials to a new mRNA vaccine that halved recurrence.

In 2026 the fight against cancer reached a turning point: Moderna’s cancer‑mRNA vaccine cut melanoma relapse by 49%, while ASCO unveiled a pancreatic drug doubling survival and a breast‑cancer strategy sparing chemotherapy. GRAIL’s Galleri test grew in demand and Tyra Biosciences’ targeted therapy entered phase‑III, all driven by record private‑sector capital. These milestones pushed oncology toward precision and prevention, offering a new lease on life for millions.
